main.description: Resume a run that paused at the HITL gate (status=interrupted) by supplying the user's decision. Re-invokes the LangGraph StateGraph with state.human_decision set; the classify_project gate short-circuits and the rest of the pipeline runs normally. Per ADR-2605080800 Phase 4.

runId.description: Original run id that paused. The resume run gets a new id and stores the original in vertex_manimani_run.parent_run_id.

decision.description: approve = let the proposed new project emerge and continue. reject = abort the run with status=completed_with_error. reassign = bind the intake to targetProjectId instead and continue.

targetProjectId.description: Required when decision=reassign. vertex_manimani_project.vertex_id in caller's actor scope.

runId.description: New run_id for the resumed StateGraph invocation.

originalRunId.description: The paused run id passed in by the caller.

errors.name: InvalidInput
errors.description: decision=reassign requires targetProjectId, or runId not paused.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: runId not found in actor scope.
